description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clone dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Clone that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Clone token instead.
